newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia minister sells Bligh shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia minister sells Bligh shares.

text.p: Australian Industry Minister John Moore has sold the remainder of his holding in Bligh Ventures for a significant loss, his office said on Thursday.
A spokeswoman for Moore said the minister had sold 42,401 Bligh shares during trade on Thursday and 600 shares during trade on Wednesday.
"That's the lot," the spokeswoman told Reuters.
"I don't know what price he sold at. I know he made a significant loss, but he won't say how much."
Bligh shares clsoed steady at A$2.10 on volume of 125,416 shares. Lance Jones broker Philip Toop said Brisbane brokerage Wilson HTM had handled about 112,000 of the shares traded.
He said most of the stock was traded at A$2.00 a share, although 5,000 shares had gone through at A$2.10.
Moore has been under pressure to sell his remaining shares in the venture capital company because of possible conflicts of interest with his portfolio area.
Breaches of Prime Minister John Howard's ministerial guidelines led to the resignation of two junior government members earlier this week and the federal opposition was targeting Moore as the third.
Under the ministerial guidelines, government members are required to divest any investments which may conflict with their portfolio area.
Moore said previously he had not breached the guidelines because he was attempting to sell his shares.
He said he was having trouble selling because the market for Bligh shares was illiquid.
